name: 王泰勛
objective:
課程主軸會圍繞電腦輔助製造，內容會教授兩套軟體，及上機實作。軟體第一套是 Vectric-Vcarve，裡面的基礎操作、CNC 加工觀念、CAM 刀路的設定還有其他加工功能都會教，第二套是 Autodesk-Fusion，會教設計模組、動畫模組、渲染模組以及出圖模組，最後也會講一些製造模組。兩套教完就會教實際使用木工 CNC 上機的部分、原點設定、工作座標的觀念、刀具的使用、材料固定方法、集塵的觀念、控制器的使用以及加工須留意的細節... 等。 然後會帶學生做產品設計到向量檔的排版以及刀路的設定及匯出，每一位同學都需要設計自己的產品以及自行在有限的材料排版設定刀路以及匯出加工檔案，最後自己操作 CNC 設備，將加工檔案製作出來，再透過木工製作的經驗，將自己的板料進行砂磨、導角、組裝以及最後成品皆需要塗裝，並製作產品表板進行簡報。 課程中也會安排同學認識國材材，除了認識不同木種的國產材、了解不同的材料特性、了解疏林以及固碳的重要性。
The main focus of this course is Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM), combining digital design, manufacturing software, hands-on CNC machining, and traditional woodworking techniques. The course is designed to guide students through the complete process from product design and digital fabrication to the production and finishing of a physical product.

The course introduces two major software platforms.

The first is Vectric VCarve, through which students learn the fundamentals of the software, basic CNC machining concepts, CAM toolpath planning and setup, as well as various advanced machining functions. Students will learn how to prepare digital designs for CNC machining, select appropriate machining strategies, configure cutting parameters, and generate machine-ready files.

The second is Autodesk Fusion, which introduces students to a more comprehensive digital product development workflow. Students will learn the Design, Animation, Rendering, and Drawing modules, as well as selected functions within the Manufacture module. Through Fusion, students develop an understanding of 3D modeling, product visualization, technical documentation, and the relationship between digital design and manufacturing.

After completing the software training, students will move on to hands-on operation of a woodworking CNC machine. The practical training covers workpiece and machine origin setting, the concept of work coordinates, tool selection and usage, material fixturing methods, dust collection, CNC controller operation, and important considerations and safety precautions during machining.

Students will then undertake an individual product development project. Each student is required to design their own product and complete the entire digital manufacturing workflow, including product design, vector file preparation, material layout and nesting, CAM toolpath generation, and machining file export.

An important part of the course is the practical application of resource-efficient manufacturing. Students are required to arrange their designs within a limited amount of material, encouraging them to consider material utilization, layout efficiency, machining requirements, and the reduction of unnecessary material waste.

After preparing their machining files, students independently operate the CNC equipment to manufacture their own products. They then apply traditional woodworking techniques to complete the physical product, including sanding, edge rounding or chamfering, assembly, and surface finishing. Each student is responsible for completing the entire production process and presenting the final product.

At the end of the project, students prepare a product presentation board and give a presentation explaining their design concept, digital manufacturing process, CNC machining process, material selection, woodworking techniques, and final product.

In addition to digital manufacturing and CNC technology, the course also introduces students to Taiwanese domestic timber and sustainable material use. Students learn to identify different species of locally produced timber and understand their material characteristics, applications, and processing properties.
